name: Microsoft Staffanstorp (Azure Sweden South)
notes: Microsoft Azure Sweden South region facility at Vastanvagen 86, Staffanstorp (Malmo-Lund axis). Region launched late 2021; Microsoft officially confirms datacenters in Gavle, Sandviken and Staffanstorp. 2022 expansion plan at Staffanstorp was dropped (DCD); Microsoft later announced deployment of 20,000 GPUs in Sweden. Site about 17 football pitches; part of Sweden South Azure region.

name: Bahnhof Sparven (Malmö)
notes: Bahnhof colocation facility in old telecom central at Storgatan 15B, Lugnet, Malmo. Listed on Bahnhof official site; fibre convergence point for southern Sweden/Scandinavia. Capacity 4 MW per third-party directory (C-grade figure).

name: GleSYS Data Center Falkenberg
notes: GleSYS headquarters and main data center in Falkenberg; staffed 24/7, 100% renewable power, surplus heat fed into district heating network (also Stockholm/Vastberga). DI reports GleSYS building new serverhall/lokaler in Falkenberg after new ownership - expansion in progress.

name: Bahnhof Bunker (Göteborg)
notes: Bahnhof announced (May 2025) underground 'Bunkerberget' data center in a 6,000 m2 former civil-defence/SKF rock bunker in Gamlestaden, central Gothenburg; site acquired from Bunkerberget AB. Elementica project cancelled in favour of this; target completion during 2026 (INTEC).

name: GlobalConnect Gothenburg
notes: Carrier colocation data center in Gothenburg operated by GlobalConnect (Nordic carrier-neutral operator); PeeringDB facility 10714 confirms presence. Address not published on PeeringDB; capacity not stated.

No verified public datacenter activity found for Varmland (Karlstad/Grums/Arvika/Kristinehamn). Only grid/energy context (Ellevio, Vattenfall) and generic municipal planning mentions; no operator, municipal permit, court or press evidence of a datacenter project as of 2026-08-12.

No verified public datacenter activity found for Orebro lan (Orebro/Kumla/Hallsberg). Multiple searches returned only logistics/rail and unrelated results; no operator, municipal detaljplan/bygglov, environmental or press evidence of a datacenter project as of 2026-08-12.

name: AWS Västerås (Kvastbruket)
developer: Amazon Web Services / Amazon Data Services Sweden AB
notes: AWS data center campus on Kvastbruket industrial area, Vasteras (30 ha, 4 data halls of 200x60 m planned, 72 diesel generators). Construction started 2017, operational (Stockholm region eu-north-1). Nacka Land & Environment Court judgment 2022-09-29 permits reserve-power expansion with total installed input up to 660 MW - this is installed reserve-power capacity, NOT IT load. Wikipedia lists Vasteras, Eskilstuna and Katrineholm as AWS Sweden sites.

name: QuickNet Data Center Västerås
notes: Small Tier-3 colocation serverhall in central Vasteras (400 m2, redundant UPS A/B feeds, backup generators). Operator page; minor facility.

name: Google Horndal (Avesta)
notes: Google's first Swedish data center on 109 ha land bought from Avesta municipality in 2017. Environmental permit granted by Land and Environment Court June 2021; marklov and bygglov granted; groundworks started Nov 2025; first spade ceremony 2 June 2026 (Byggvarlden) with minister present; Google says completion target 2028 with ~100 permanent jobs. Construction status confirmed by SVT/Byggvarlden (B) plus Avesta municipal pages (A).

name: EcoDataCenter 1 (Falun)
notes: EcoDataCenter Falun (EDC1) operational campus, official page states 80 MW available power; carbon-negative wood-framed data halls; served as host for CoreWeave AI workloads; 2022 expansion of ~SEK 1 billion at Falun (Byggvarlden).

name: EcoDataCenter 2 (Borlänge / Kvarnsveden)
capacity_notes: 250 MW available at launch, campus scale-up up to 600 MW
notes: EcoDataCenter 2 mega campus on former Kvarnsveden paper-mill site, Borlange. Official page: up to 600 MW; construction started 2025 (groundbreak reported Sept 2025; ByggfaktaDOCU: construction start Oct 2025, 1000-2000 MSEK); first data centre scheduled for completion 2027 with 250 MW at launch; EUR 600m Deutsche Bank debt financing (Sept 2025) supports Falun+Borlange build-out.

name: Microsoft Gävle (Ersbo / Stackbo / Tuna)
notes: Microsoft Sweden Central Azure region data centers at Ersbo, Stackbo (Valbo) and Tuna in Gavle municipality; land bought 2018-2019 from Gavle and Sandviken municipalities (66 ha Ersbo, 200 ha Stackbo); region operational since late 2021. Stackbo approved for up to ten data halls (GD.se); GVX03 Ersbo facility documented. Gavle municipality official establishment page confirms ongoing construction.

name: Microsoft Sandviken
notes: Microsoft data center in Sandviken as part of Sweden Central region (officially confirmed by Microsoft). Large Sandviken build-out was paused (Computersweden: 'jattebygge i Sandviken pa is'), while Ersbo/Stackbo continued; Sandviken municipality maintains a datacenter-industry establishment page.

name: Ockelbo Valhalla industrial area (datacenter planning)
notes: Ockelbo municipality detailed plan (detaljplan) for Valhalla industrial area out for samrad since 2025-02-24; methodology flags this as datacenter-related planning lead in Gavleborg. No named operator or building permit yet - planning-stage record only.

name: atNorth SWE04 (Sollefteå, Hamre)
notes: atNorth confirmed 2026-02-23 plans for 300 MW high-density AI/HPC data center campus (SWE04) at Hamre Industrial Park, Langsele, Solleftea municipality (50 ha site Hamre 1); scheduled operational H1 2028. Earlier land agreement (2024) cited initial 200 MW. Official atNorth news release + trade press.

name: Google Torsboda (Timrå/Sundsvall)
notes: Google designated buyer of the whole Torsboda Industrial Park AB (Timra/Sundsvall, jointly municipally owned) for ~911 MSEK to build an AI data center (~500 direct jobs); municipal sale decisions pending 17 Aug 2026 (Expressen); electricity-price concerns reported (SVT). Status: announced, pending municipal decision.

name: EcoDataCenter Östersund (Verksmon) - cancelled
capacity_notes: 150 MW campus was planned (DCD, 2024); cancelled Sept 2025
notes: EcoDataCenter 'Ecosystem' project in Verksmon, Ostersund (planned 150 MW campus + greenhouse, up to 1,000 jobs; samrad Jan 2024) was scrapped in September 2025 - Ostersund municipality official page confirms the project will not proceed; EcoDataCenter concentrates on Dalarna instead. Recorded as rejected/cancelled.
